name: Wülfrath (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wülfrath (a shepherd with a dog on red).
history: Municipal flag of Wülfrath; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wülfrath arms — shepherd with dog on red
